title: Golden hour over a small exterior set
summary: Low sun with long shadows reads as late afternoon; most failures come from a sun that is too high and shadows that are too soft.
applies_when: exterior scene meant to feel warm or nostalgic
village, landscape or diorama viewed from 5 to 30 metres

values.sun_azimuth: 30-60 degrees off the hero camera axis, never straight behind
values.tone_mapping: ACES Filmic, or AgX if highlights on water or metal clip

checks: shadows are longer than the objects are tall
lit faces and shadow faces stay separable at overview distance
no crushed blacks in the shadow side of the hero object
specular highlights on water or metal do not clip to white
limits: does not cover interiors seen through windows
no claim about physically accurate sun position for a real date or place
